title: Wrong access VLAN
symptom: PC has an IP address but cannot reach another PC in the same intended VLAN
show_output: Fa0/3 assigned to VLAN 20; expected VLAN is 30

title: Missing VLAN
symptom: PC cannot communicate with devices in VLAN 20
topology_note: PC connected to SW1; VLAN 20 should exist
show_output: VLAN 20 not present in show vlan brief
expected_fix: Create VLAN 20 and assign required port

title: Trunk VLAN missing
symptom: Devices across switches cannot communicate
topology_note: SW1 connected to SW2 using trunk
show_output: Trunk is up but VLAN 30 is not allowed
expected_fault: Trunk does not carry required VLAN

title: Access port shutdown
symptom: PC has no network connectivity
show_output: Fa0/5 is administratively down

title: Native VLAN mismatch
symptom: Inter-switch connectivity is unstable
topology_note: SW1 and SW2 connected by trunk
show_output: Native VLAN differs between switches

title: Wrong subnet mask
symptom: PC cannot reach its gateway
show_output: PC configured with incorrect subnet mask

title: Wrong default gateway
symptom: PC can reach local devices but not remote network
topology_note: PC connected to SW1 and routed by R1
show_output: PC gateway points to wrong router

title: Duplicate IP
symptom: Two PCs have intermittent connectivity
topology_note: PC1 and PC2 connected to same switch
show_output: Two devices use the same IP address

title: Missing route
symptom: PC can reach local gateway but not remote server
topology_note: R1 connected to R2 and server network
show_output: Destination network missing from routing table
expected_fix: Add required route or routing advertisement

title: Incorrect static route
symptom: Remote network unreachable
show_output: Static route points to incorrect next hop

title: OSPF neighbor down
symptom: Routes are missing between routers
show_output: OSPF neighbor is not in FULL state

title: OSPF area mismatch
symptom: Two routers cannot form OSPF adjacency
topology_note: R1 and R2 connected through Ethernet
show_output: OSPF interfaces use different areas

title: Interface IP mismatch
symptom: Two routers cannot communicate
show_output: Interfaces are configured with incompatible IP networks
verification: Router interfaces can ping each other

title: Interface protocol down
symptom: Router link is unavailable
show_output: Interface status is up but line protocol is down

title: Missing default route
symptom: Router cannot reach external network
topology_note: R1 connects LAN to upstream router
show_output: Default route is absent

title: DHCP pool exhausted
symptom: New PC does not receive an IP address
topology_note: Multiple PCs connected to DHCP-enabled network
show_output: DHCP pool has no available addresses

title: DHCP wrong network
symptom: PC receives incorrect IP range
show_output: DHCP pool network does not match VLAN subnet

title: DHCP gateway missing
symptom: PC gets IP but cannot reach remote networks
show_output: DHCP pool has no default-router option
verification: PC reaches gateway and remote networks

title: DHCP excluded range issue
symptom: Some addresses are unexpectedly unavailable
show_output: Too many addresses are excluded from DHCP pool

title: DHCP server unreachable
symptom: PC does not receive DHCP address
topology_note: PC and DHCP server are in different VLANs
show_output: DHCP relay/helper configuration is missing

title: DNS server incorrect
symptom: PC can ping IP but cannot resolve hostname
show_output: DNS server address is incorrect

title: DNS record missing
symptom: Server hostname cannot be resolved
show_output: Required DNS record is absent

title: DNS connectivity failure
symptom: PC cannot resolve names and cannot reach DNS server
topology_note: PC connected to DNS server through router
show_output: DNS server is unreachable
expected_fix: Restore network path to DNS server

title: ACL denies traffic
symptom: PC can reach gateway but not server
topology_note: Router ACL between PC and server
show_output: ACL contains deny rule for required traffic
expected_fix: Correct or remove incorrect ACL entry

title: ACL applied wrong interface
symptom: Unexpected traffic is blocked
show_output: ACL is applied inbound instead of intended interface

title: ACL blocks DNS
symptom: Web access fails by hostname but IP works
show_output: ACL denies UDP/TCP DNS traffic

title: ACL blocks SSH
symptom: Administrator cannot remotely access router
show_output: ACL denies TCP port 22

title: NAT not translating
symptom: Inside PC cannot access external server
show_output: NAT translation is not occurring
expected_fix: Correct NAT inside/outside or translation rule

title: NAT inside interface missing
symptom: Internal hosts cannot access outside network
topology_note: R1 has LAN and WAN interfaces
show_output: LAN interface is not marked ip nat inside
expected_fix: Mark LAN interface as ip nat inside

title: NAT outside interface missing
symptom: Internal hosts cannot access external server
show_output: External interface is not marked ip nat outside
expected_fix: Mark WAN interface as ip nat outside

title: NAT ACL incorrect
symptom: Some internal hosts cannot access internet
show_output: ACL does not match internal subnet

title: Wireless wrong SSID
symptom: Client cannot connect to expected wireless network
topology_note: Wireless client connects to access point
show_output: Client attempts to use incorrect SSID

title: Wireless authentication failure
symptom: Client sees SSID but cannot authenticate
show_output: Client uses incorrect security key

title: Wireless VLAN mismatch
symptom: Wireless client connects but cannot reach internal resources
topology_note: AP connects wireless clients to VLAN 20
show_output: Wireless VLAN mapping does not match expected VLAN

title: Wireless gateway issue
symptom: Wireless client receives IP but cannot reach remote network
show_output: Client receives incorrect default gateway
